title: Mind & Society: is AI making us lonely?
summary: In 2025, MIT Media Lab and OpenAI found that the heaviest chatbot users reported more loneliness and dependence. What the studies show, and what they don't.
ticker: MIND & SOCIETY · IS AI MAKING US LONELY? · MIT MEDIA LAB AND OPENAI, 2025

say: Millions of people talk to chatbots every day. Is it making us lonely?
In March 2025, MIT Media Lab and OpenAI published two studies on how chatbot use affects how people feel.

label: PEOPLE
FOUR WEEKS OF CHATGPT
say: MIT followed about a thousand people using ChatGPT for four weeks.
The heaviest daily users reported more loneliness, more emotional dependence, and less time with other people.
But the studies do not show that chatbots cause loneliness. Lonely people may simply reach for them more.
They measured loneliness, not depression, over just a month, and had not been peer reviewed.
If a chatbot is your main conversation of the day, that is worth noticing.
